bio.text: Anne Gerwig represents District 93 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Gerwig was elected in 2024.
Gerwig was a member of the Wellington, Florida, village council from 2010 to 2016 and mayor of Wellington from 2016 to 2024.
The House lists Gerwig's residence as Wellington and an occupation of CADD drafter for engineers and surveyors. Gerwig was born in Warsaw, Indiana, and moved to Florida in 1969.
